prompt: An ancient elf druid whose body has half-become the grove itself: bark-textured skin, a long moss-and-lichen beard, antler-like branches growing from his head, deep emerald and verdigris robes. He stands hunched in a forward profile facing south-west, both gnarled hands lowered to the forest floor where two bright lime-green columns of mana light rise up between his fingers, channeled from glowing roots. Faint green sap-light glows from cracks within his bark skin. The background is a dense old-growth forest of dark mossy trunks and dappled canopy light.

A venerable ancient elf druid kneeling on a raised root-dais in a forest grove, plunging both hands into glowing tangled roots, drawing two bright lime-green columns of mana light upward from the earth. He wears deep emerald robes, has a long grey braided beard, pointed elf ears, and a crown of woven leaves. His face is calm and powerful. The only strong light source is the green mana glow rising from the roots, underlighting his face. The background is a dense old-growth forest of dark mossy trunks and dappled canopy light.
